{\fontsize{10.5}{12.5}\selectfont Values are means over the three held-out target cell lines (A549, K562 and MCF7), each weighted equally. For ReCA and ReCA+Res, the second line gives the paired difference from Raw with its pointwise 95\% interval (10,000 paired drug resamples within each target cell line). Raw trains on observed responses; ReCA trains on direct ReCA estimates; ReCA+Res predicts the ReCA estimate and the observed-minus-ReCA residual in separate branches and sums them, as for BBBC047 in Table~3. All arms were capacity-matched and evaluated against the same observed target profiles. PCC, full-profile correlation after adding the matched Vehicle baseline; $\Delta$PCC, correlation of control-subtracted responses; $E$, perturbation specificity (same-drug minus other-drug Fisher-$z$ agreement). With two measurements per condition, the sci-Plex3 ReCA adaptation reduces aggregated-target IMR to IMR and uses diagonal shrinkage (Supplementary Methods). Seen-drug transfer uses drugs that were also in the source training set.\par}
